items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was one Williams that went up with Handy and played with him. Do you know if it was a man that traveled with? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I couldn't say it.

ctx.x: I imagine about sixteen pieces. Big band. Oh yeah, it was a large band, yes sir. He had a brother, he used to play trombone but he died. He used to play in that high register all the time. He thought there was a trumpet playing all the time. He died of consumption.
There was one Williams that went up with Handy and played with him. Do you know if it was a man that traveled with?

No, I couldn't say it. Only William I know as Professor Williams and his brother played bass and his son George. I think he's now in Baton Rouge. He has an orchestra out of Baton Rouge. What type of music did they use? Were they everything arranged? That is they used the music?
